security.question: How do you handle my bank credentials?
security.answer: We use Enable Banking, a certified Open Banking provider, to connect to your bank. Your login credentials are never shared with or stored by Sossoldi — they go directly to your bank through secure, encrypted channels. We only receive transaction data, never your passwords.

pricing.question: Is Sossoldi still free?
pricing.answer: Yes! The core Sossoldi app is completely free and open-source. You can use all local features without paying anything. In the future, certain cloud-based features (like cross-device sync or advanced API integrations) may be offered as a premium 'Product' tier, but the core experience will always remain free.

contribution.question: How can I contribute to the project?
contribution.answer: We love contributions from the community! You can help by reporting bugs, suggesting features, improving documentation, or submitting pull requests. Check out our Contributing Guide on GitHub to get started.

openSource.question: Why is Sossoldi open source?
openSource.answer: Transparency is at the heart of personal finance management. By being open source, we ensure you can verify exactly how your data is handled, contribute improvements, and trust that there are no hidden trackers or data selling. It's the Mr. RIP community philosophy: honest, transparent, and community-driven.
